browser.limitations: Clearance uses conservative world XZ bounds of actual transformed vertices, not triangle-triangle collision. The exact terrain-ray grounding case is in flat far-water terrain; initial placement checks the lowest rendered vertex against its configured offset.

visual.fixture: Desktop and phone reef views use normal movement and inspection. Three detail views reposition only the paused camera and hide overlays; actual world colonies, actors, lighting, geometry and materials are unchanged.

checks: one indexed geometry, no material groups
geometry.note: One static mesh per colony. Illustrative growth forms; no frame-rate claim.

sourceReview: Scoped read-only audit found no actionable correctness issues in placement, inactive pooling, recycling timing, resource ownership or inspection interactions.
determinism: Geometry and resolver consume zero random draws. Initial construction draw sequence and per-candidate recycle draws are preserved; changed colony locations can alter future recycling timing.

oceanReuse.recommendation: Share small scene components; keep Hunter focused and build a separate bounded reef experience with an independent ecological model.
